title: Six-loop product convergence
summary: User-approved 30-slice umbrella contract with rank and human-review boundaries.

sourceRefs.summary: Run-contract target that explains why this generated contract exists.
Approved rationale, exact slices, acceptance, preservation, rollback, verification, and stop conditions.
Accepted six-loop order and promotion boundary.

allowedWork: Implement only the 30 approved slices, focused tests, stable visual harness extensions, performance measurements, adjacent proven pruning, and durable project/Theseus evidence.
Continue unrelated objective slices after a visual exemplar is review-ready while freezing that exemplar against promotion or generalization.
disallowedWork: Do not infer human catalogue dispositions, aesthetic approval, explanation wording approval, promotion certificates, or rank advancement.
Do not build a universal renderer, scene graph, motif registry, domain engine, arbitrary code runner, live LLM service, public website, or curriculum.
goal: Converge catalogue truth, generated solve-x, public API, vector projection, capability performance, and programming hosting to one consolidated human checkpoint.
stopConditions: Stop on competing execution authority, source-of-truth conflict, or unavoidable overlap with unrelated user-owned files.
Stop visual work on each review-ready exemplar; defer all promotion and generalization to the consolidated human checkpoint.

Stop if 3D hosting needs eager WebGL or another runtime; generated solve-x needs provider authority; API pruning removes a live caller; vector needs a new graph engine; performance needs widened targets or fidelity loss; or programming needs arbitrary execution.
Stop when required verification is missing, contradictory, or cannot be recorded durably.

slices.title: Freeze catalogue truth contract
slices.summary: Corrected catalogue truth: all 35 assets load; 32 have meaningful native paint; Graph3D and two programming slots are explicit gaps. Generic SVG chrome no longer counts as 3D paint.

slices.title: Define native 3D host contract
slices.summary: Defined the exact native Graph3D catalogue host contract over the existing semantic model and Three capability; added typed lifecycle outcomes, shared WebGL leases, context-loss/static fallback, accessible state, and complementary rewind projection without mounting a second runtime.

slices.title: Host canonical 3D reference
slices.summary: Hosted the exact saddle Graph3D transition in the persistent catalogue through semantic SVG and selected-visible Three.js, sampled one retained renderer from the shared clock, upgraded this caller to pooled WebGL2, and proved in-place lease release plus context-loss fallback. Catalogue truth is now 33 meaningful paints and two programming gaps.

slices.title: Capture 3D and curation evidence
slices.summary: Captured and manually inspected wide, narrow, semantic SVG fallback, and context-loss Graph3D checkpoints through the stable catalogue command. Restored canonical semantic axes, contained fallback overflow, hid accessible status visually, and froze remaining scale/parity/pedagogy questions without assigning a disposition.

slices.title: Freeze generated trace bridge
slices.summary: Frozen exact-provider generated trace bridge with stable instance identity, subtract/divide support, provenance retention, and typed fail-closed diagnostics; 9 focused tests plus type and architecture gates pass.

slices.title: Compile generated solve-x asset
slices.summary: Compiled the accepted subtract/divide provider trace into one canonical KpAnimationAsset with 6 instance-scoped states, 5 trusted generated transformations, exact frame/operation lineage, 2 settled checkpoints, static export, deterministic direct seek, and mirrored rewind.
